gen-gf-inria-serif-fs-bespoke-sans: Refined and a bit old-world, Inria Serif has curves that swell gently. Bespoke Sans sits beside it with sharp, low-contrast strokes and generous gaps where curves meet stems, so a long passage moves along smoothly without a snag.
gen-gf-intel-one-mono-fs-literata: Typewriter-tidy and loose-limbed. Intel One Mono spaces its letters out like a row of fenced plots, while Literata's sturdy strokes add a bookish warmth, and that mix of structure and softness is the draw.
gen-gf-iosevka-charon-fs-bespoke-sans: Iosevka Charon sets fixed-width, code-style letters with a single-weight line, the kind a plotter pen would draw. Bespoke Sans lightens the mood, sharp and refined beside it.
gen-gf-iosevka-charon-fs-literata: Code-style letters meet a bookish partner. Iosevka Charon has no thick or thin parts anywhere, while Literata's text serif curves swing between heavier and lighter strokes, and that gap between machine and page is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-iosevka-charon-mono-fs-bespoke-sa: Bespoke Sans takes the body, sharp and refined. Iosevka Charon Mono supplies fixed-width letters drawn with a flat fineliner line, and its structured, technical streak against that low-contrast softness is what stands out most.
gen-gf-iosevka-charon-mono-fs-literata: Literata brings a bookish body whose thin parts are only slightly slimmer than its stems, with wide, unclosed curves. Iosevka Charon Mono never varies its stroke at all, and that steady line against Literata's mild pen-like shifts is the draw.
gen-gf-istok-web-fs-literata: Letters held open rather than curled shut give Istok Web a contemporary, neutral look. Literata follows with sturdy thin lines and slightly heavier thick ones, a bookish classic serif, while Istok Web earns its keep on big, short headings.
gen-gf-italiana-fs-literata: Literata reads like a bookish classic serif, with sturdy lines and a modest weight shift inside each stroke. Italiana is best at sharp swings from fat to fine, with a hairline-topped bold a, while Literata is best at quietly carrying the text.
gen-gf-junge-fs-bespoke-sans: Traditional and refined, Junge has thin strokes just lighter than its thick ones, a shift you feel more than see. Bespoke Sans is sharper and flatter beside it, with generous gaps between curves and stems.
gen-gf-jura-fs-literata: Literata is the bookish body here, its curves wide and unclosed, with a mild pen-like variation. Jura, clean and modern, never shows a hairline, while Literata softens the page with those gentle weight shifts.
